decisions.reason: As an extension of an already popular Demeter yogurt range that remained on the website across 2023 and 2024, it fits the firm's existing organic dairy knowledge closely and is therefore likely to be improved rather than withdrawn.

Mild sliced cheese is very close to the firm's established dairy processing and marketing capabilities, so management would typically keep it on the market to exploit and refine what it already knows unless early sales are clearly weak.

Sliced butter cheese also builds directly on the firm's core cheese know-how, but as a newer 2024 line extension with only initial market evidence and some overlap risk in the assortment, it has a somewhat higher chance of being dropped than the yogurt.
